body: Forward test of the promise-tracker method (not a recommendation). Probability 0.70 that: Uniparts Q3 FY27 revenue within ±7% of Q1 FY27 (~₹347 cr), i.e. ₹323–371 cr. Reason: Numeric/cycle guidance under current CEO hit ~78%; Q3 seasonally weak; freight and farm weakness are risks. Resolve by 2027-02-28; score with Brier.
title: Paper call: Uniparts Q3 FY27 revenue within ±7% of Q1 FY27 (~₹347 cr), i.e. ₹323–371 cr
